text:
maya: FYI - fenrir-7b weights + tokenizer landed in s3://redwood-models/incoming/fenrir-7b/txn-31415. Need onboarding checklist: checksum validation, provenance metadata, registry entry, storage tiering (ephemeral -> cold), and safelist for early deploys. Who can own?

sam: I'll take initial validation. ETA ~2h. Can ops create a temp bucket with lifecycle so we don't clutter main registry?

ingest-bot: Artifact received: fenrir-7b-weights.bin (13.4GB), tokenizer vocab (fenrir-vocab.json). Manifest: s3://redwood-models/incoming/fenrir-7b/_manifest.json

kevin: paste the sha outputs. if mismatch we stop. if match, push to registry with a staging flag.

jen: quick reminder: include tokenizer hash + vocab version in the provenance metadata (provenance.tokenizer_hash and provenance.vocab_version). Also record ingest.source (partner-x).

ops: created temp bucket: s3://redwood-temp-ingest/2103456789-fenrir with lifecycle: 7d hot -> move to cold. KMS CMK attached.

security: require object ACL private and restrict GetObject to role:arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/staging-ingest. Also we need an immutable ledger entry (artifact-ledger) with signer and timestamp before registry create.

maya: assigning eval owners: @kevin for perf, @jen for QA/regressions. Plan quantization experiments after basic smoke evals (target 8-bit). Track via eval suite id `lm-smoke-v2`.

sam: steps I'm running now:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-models/incoming/fenrir-7b/_manifest.json .
jq -r '.files[] | [.path, .sha256] | @tsv' _manifest.json
sha256sum fenrir-7b-weights.bin
```
sha256 matched expected hash for weights and tokenizer.

kevin: when you register, include these registry fields: model.family, model.version, format, quant_ready, kv_cache_supported, provenance list, storage_policy. Example registry payload I used before:
```
{
  "model.family":"fenrir",
  "model.version":"7b-rc1",
  "format":"pytorch",
  "quant_ready":"unknown",
  "kv_cache_supported":"true",
  "provenance":["partner-x","2026-03-20"],
  "storage_policy":"ephemeral->cold7d",
  "ingest_manifest":"s3://redwood-models/incoming/fenrir-7b/_manifest.json"
}
```
Make sure to set quant_ready=false until we run quant experiments.

jen: also add smoke prompts under evals: s3://redwood-evals/fenrir-7b/smoke.json and tag the registry entry with eval_suite:lm-smoke-v2. Add baseline hashes so we can detect regressions after quant.

maya: good. Sam - please create registry id, ledger entry, and set lifecycle on temp bucket. Post links here when done. :thumbsup:

sam: done. Registry id: reg-20260320-31415. Ledger txn: ledger://txn/31415 (signed by maya). Bucket lifecycle set and objects copied to temp bucket. Smoke prompts uploaded -> s3://redwood-evals/fenrir-7b/smoke.json

ingest-bot: safelist rule applied: early deploy allowed only for `dev` and `dedicated-staging` groups. Production deploy blocked until QA signoff.

kevin: will kick off perf tests and a quick fp16 -> int8 quant bakeoff next week, tracking results in #quant-experiments.

jen: I'll run QA smoke + regression checks today and update registry tags if anything fails.

maya: thanks all. Closing handoff — file registry id and ledger refs in onboarding ticket.
